questions.stem: State the complementary partner of each DNA base.
questions.modelAnswer: Adenine pairs with thymine, and cytosine pairs with guanine.

questions.stem: Describe a DNA molecule using the words polymer, strands and helix.
questions.modelAnswer: DNA is a polymer of two strands coiled together as a double helix.

questions.stem: Explain why the word template is used for each half of the double helix.
questions.modelAnswer: Because bases pair in a fixed way, an existing strand determines exactly which bases join its partner, so each half guides the rebuilding of a complete identical helix.

questions.stem: One DNA strand reads A-T-G-C along a region. Write the sequence its partner strand must carry in that region.
questions.modelAnswer: The partner must read T-A-C-G, since A faces T and C faces G in complementary pairing.
